title: Can Watermelon Protect iPhone X From Giant Bear Trap?!
description: Watermelons are big, but they aren't exactly that durable, so when I heard someone suggest that I try putting an iPhone X inside a watermelon and test it with a bear trap, I couldn't resist. The problem is I wrote down who suggested the idea during my livestream, but then I lost my saved document, so now I'm not sure who suggested it. But shoutout to the person who suggested it!
author: GizmoSlip
